title: Blink timer wraps around
prompt: The robot's light blinks on a timer t that grows by delta each frame and wraps back to zero every period seconds. Return the new t after adding delta and wrapping. With t at 0.9, delta 0.2 and a period of 1.0, the answer is 0.1.
starter:
func blink_timer(t, delta, period) -> float:
	return t + delta
hints: Add first, then take the remainder of dividing by the period.
fmod() is the remainder for decimals.

docs.name: fmod(a, b)
docs.what: Returns the remainder of a divided by b, for decimals. fmod(1.1, 1.0) is 0.1.

solution:
func blink_timer(t, delta, period) -> float:
	return fmod(t + delta, period)
